images.edition: Briefwisseling van Anthonie Heinsius, Deel 18, GS244
images.content: H.W. Rumpf to Heinsius, 17 Nov 1716 -- printed numeral ciphertext embedded in French prose, with footnote 3: 'Het cijferschrift is door d'Alonne niet opgelost.'

note: One representative page fetched and confirmed by eye per check-solved brief; letters 309 (p.555), 446 (pp.302-303) and 455 (p.337) were read as OCR text (html_url) only, not imaged, this pass -- their ciphertext is stated by the editor to be omitted from the print entirely ('weggelaten'), so no printed-edition image of them would show cipher anyway; only the Nationaal Archief originals (H.A. 2030/2044 and the unresolved H.A. for 455) would carry that ciphertext.
